before.title: Offline Codex preflight can accept an effort that ordinary startup rejects
before.body:
Origin: the independent Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh review of #448, [original review](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/448#issuecomment-7060237320). This is a pre-existing P3 follow-up, outside #448's bounded missing-seed projection. Source is signed main `02351e2fb932b3be44e7cc3fb3943a61d568226c`; the reviewed candidate preserves this behavior. This record is not implementation or acceptance.

`apps/api/src/preflight.ts:265-289` checks only Codex model membership and enabled state. Ordinary startup also validates the selected effort through `validateHarnessDefaults`. For a configured `gpt-5.5` / `none`, offline preflight can report the default ready and exit 0, while startup rejects `EFFORT_UNSUPPORTED`. The maintained #448 regression at `apps/api/src/preflight-catalog.test.ts:203-211` records the existing disagreement rather than fixing it.

Acceptance when separately dispatched:
- Reproduce with disposable supported/current stores and the public offline command/startup; include supported-effort and missing-effort controls.
- Make the Codex default result truthfully account for the effective effort, with no model/provider turn or automatic substitution.
- Preserve read-only database/WAL behavior, stored enabled preferences, existing harness readiness separation and the documented SQLite SHM reader exception.
- Do not silently align Codex/Claude disabled-model severity or expand model retirement policy; select any such product change separately.
- Update preflight documentation and meaningful positive/negative tests; retain numerical coverage, independent QA, opposite-family review and current-target CI.

Duplicate check included open/closed preflight-title, preflight/effort, pending-migration and startup/seed searches; #448 covers missing seeds, #179 CLI prerequisite capability and #132 template-catalog repeated work. None owns this effort-check discrepancy. Delivery: parked backlog, no implementation gate; proposed Sol xhigh implementation and Opus xhigh review. Not added to the current 26-core-issue batch.
